title: "Still 2 days, there's still going to be 10 wickets we need" | Mitchell Starc press conference
quote_text:
Mitchell Starc: "Look we're not putting a time frame on it obviously we've gone out with the bat again to I guess the result of how we've bowled today has given us that opportunity to explore a few options in how we want to approach it yeah by no means are we are we thinking too far ahead all we've done is given ourselves a really good opportunity to I guess dictate the game in any number of options we want to take so they're still two days there's still going to be 10 wickets we need to take you don't get any extra points to finish the game early so yeah look we want to keep going about our business the way we have for the first three days it's been really really impressive how we've gone about it with the bat obviously in the first two days and then today is a group with the ball so yeah I’m sure that the guys will sit back tonight and have a think and come tomorrow with a really clear plan and we'll go ahead and do our best to try and try and win this test match."
